note: Jalali entries are fixed Persian-calendar days. Lunar entries are Islamic civil-calendar days computed on-device and shifted by the lunar adjustment preference, so they follow every year automatically. Gregorian entries are fixed Gregorian days converted to Jalali each year, so international observances never duplicate. The optional yearly section overrides the base catalog for one Jalali year: add occasions (for example Chaharshanbe Suri and Quds Day, which follow the lunar week) or list titleEn values in removeTitlesEn to hide them.
